crossRefs.note: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.
He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.
When king David came to Bahurim, behold, a man of the family of Saul’s house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son…
Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”
Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,
saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”
Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…

translations.web: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.
translations.bsb: Because God has unstrung my bow and afflicted me, they have cast off restraint in my presence.
translations.kjv: Because he hath loosed my cord, and afflicted me, they have also let loose the bridle before
translations.asv: For he hath loosed his cord, and afflicted me; And they have cast off the bridle before me.
